langley-holiday-events-november-december.name: Aldergrove Christmas Tree Lighting
langley-holiday-events-november-december.description: Aldergrove's Christmas tree lighting, 4 to 7 p.m. at 270 Street and Fraser Highway.

langley-holiday-events-november-december.description: Festivities start at 2 p.m. on the front grounds of the Fort Langley Community Hall; the children's choir sings at 4:45 p.m. and the tree is lit at 5:30 p.m.

langley-holiday-events-november-december.name: Langley Christmas Village
langley-holiday-events-november-december.description: Free Christmas village along Fraser Highway in downtown Langley City, November 26 to December 24.

langley-holiday-events-november-december.description: A free community party from 3 to 6 p.m., then the light up parade at 6 p.m. through downtown Aldergrove.
